exposure: type of Copper containing intrauterine contraceptive devices (IUCDs)
timing of IUCD insertion (postpartum vs. post-placental)
finding: There was no significant difference in expulsion rates between the two types of IUCDs, but the expulsion rate was significantly higher in the vaginal delivery group and in the early postpartum insertion group.
mod_finding: The expulsion rate was significantly higher in the vaginal delivery group than in the caesarean section group.
